name: Mutual Home Exchange Local Listings
author: mutualhomeexchange

sections.description:
Tenants of councils and housing associations can swap homes with each other. This plugin adds a small panel to your site showing the homes to swap nearest to your readers, with a photo, the number of bedrooms, the type of home, the rent and how far away it is. It updates itself, so you never have to touch it again.

It suits local newspapers, community websites, parish and town council sites, and local services whose readers may want to move into or out of your area.

  • Block, widget and shortcode. Use whichever suits your theme.
  • Nearest first. Homes inside your chosen distance come first (5 miles by default). If there are only a few, the nearest ones further afield are added under a “Further afield” heading, so the panel is never empty.
  • Public information only. The panel shows only what is already public on each home’s page: the photo, title, bedrooms, type, rent and postcode district. Never the street. The panel sets no cookies and does not profile or track visitors.
  • Light, dark or automatic colours, and your own accent colour.
  • Free. No account, no payment, no contract. A small “Powered by MutualHomeExchange.co.uk” link is available under the panel, but it is off unless you switch it on in the settings.

Shortcode

[mhe_local_listings location="Worthing" radius="5" count="3" layout="side"]

Options: location (a town or a full postcode), radius (1 to 50 miles), count (1 to 6), layout (side or strip), theme (auto, light or dark), accent (six hex digits, for example e8a33d), key (an optional partner key). Anything you leave out comes from Settings > Mutual Home Exchange Local Listings.

External services

This plugin shows a panel that is loaded, in a frame, from the Mutual Home Exchange service at https://www.mutualhomeexchange.co.uk. The panel is the plugin’s whole purpose, so the service is needed for it to work.

  • What is sent: when a visitor views a page with the panel, their browser requests the panel from mutualhomeexchange.co.uk. That request carries the town or postcode, distance and look you chose, the plugin version, and the address of the page showing the panel (without any query string). The service also receives the visitor’s IP address and browser details, as any website does. Nothing else is sent. The service does not keep a record of who viewed a panel, and does not use cookies or build visitor profiles. It counts how many times a panel is shown, per website and page.
  • When: on every page view that contains the panel.
  • If a visitor opens a home, they leave your site for mutualhomeexchange.co.uk, and its terms and privacy policy apply.
  • Service: Mutual Home Exchange. Terms: https://www.mutualhomeexchange.co.uk/terms.php and, for publishers, https://www.mutualhomeexchange.co.uk/publisher-terms.php. Privacy policy: https://www.mutualhomeexchange.co.uk/privacy.php (see “Publisher panels and the WordPress plugin”).
  • To protect the service from abuse, each panel load is limited per visitor and per website. For this, a one-way scrambled (hashed) form of the visitor’s IP address is held for under an hour, only to count requests. It is not linked to anything else, cannot be turned back into the address, and is then deleted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it, or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Go to Settings > Mutual Home Exchange Local Listings and enter your town or postcode.
  3. Add the “Mutual Home Exchange Local Listings” block to a page, or the widget to a sidebar, or paste the shortcode.
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything?

No. It is free, and so is the data.

Can I show a different place on different pages?

Yes. Give each block, widget or shortcode its own town or postcode.

Does it slow my site down?

The panel loads in a frame after your page, so it does not hold your page up.

Why do I see homes that are not very near?

When fewer homes than you asked for are within your distance, the nearest ones further afield are added under a “Further afield” heading, each with its distance.

Is a partner key needed?

No. A free key from mutualhomeexchange.co.uk/publishers.php ties the panel to your site so that no one else can copy it.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • New plugin name, Mutual Home Exchange Local Listings. The shortcode is now [mhe_local_listings].
  • The settings page script is now loaded with the proper WordPress functions.
  • Clearer wording about what the service receives and keeps.
  • The “Powered by” credit is off unless you switch it on.

1.0.1

  • New setting: show or hide the small “Powered by” credit link under the panel.
  • A logo on the settings page.
  • Settings page: a shortcode builder (choose your options, copy the shortcode) and a list of every option.
  • Settings page: the accent colour box is wide enough to show a full colour code.

1.0.0

  • First release.
